moveHint: Choose an empty folder. Checking, copying and verification run automatically after you start.
moveBehavior: After verification, this app switches to the destination and removes the original workspace folder. If removal fails, the verified destination stays available and cleanup can be retried without copying again. Other open tabs must reload.
copyBehavior: After verification, this app switches to the copy. The original stays in its current folder. These are independent copies; they do not synchronize. Other open tabs must reload.
moveDone: Workspace moved and verified. The original folder has been removed.
copyDone: Verified copy opened. The original workspace remains in its previous folder.
moveSourceChanged: The original changed after it was copied. It has been kept intact. Review those changes before attempting removal again.
moveCleanupHint: The verified destination is open. Removal of the original has not finished. Retry checks the original before removing it and does not repeat the file transfer.
copyUnconfirmed: Could not confirm the transfer. Check your connection, then reload Observanda to check the current workspace.
portableHint: Export this workspace and its projects, including their encrypted records, history, files and settings. Choose an empty folder you can take to the other computer.
portableAccessHint: Verify the password or recovery key you will use on the other computer. Device unlock belongs to this computer. If needed, cancel and configure a password or recovery key in Storage & access first.
portableSize: {files} files / {megabytes} MB, including retained research and original evidence.
portableKeepsSource: The current workspace stays open. The verified copy stays portable until you open it in Observanda. The two copies do not synchronize.
portableNext: Open this folder in Observanda on the other computer. Unlock the workspace with its password or recovery key, then unlock each project with its own password or recovery key.
portableLocalSettings: GitHub sign-in and device-protected credentials stay on this computer; reconnect them on the new one. Back up your collaboration identity separately if you need to continue using it.
relocationHint: Move relocates the complete managed workspace, including its database. Close the workspace before moving its folder outside Observanda. For a different operating system, create a portable copy. A NAS must support PostgreSQL filesystem durability and locking; a successful folder check alone does not establish that.
missingDatabase: This workspace’s research database is not available on this installation. Create a portable workspace copy from Storage & access on the original computer, then open that complete copy here.
openHint: Select the complete workspace folder. When transferring between operating systems, use a portable workspace copy created in Observanda.
passwordHint: Enter the password for this workspace.
authorized: This device is authorized. Unlock with your operating-system account.
missingRecord: This folder has no workspace record.
missingFolder: This folder is no longer available.
copyHint: Choose an empty folder, or the destination of an interrupted copy. Records, history, files and access settings are included.
remembered: Remembers workspace locations and app text and menu settings.
resetHint: Clear remembered locations and app text and menu settings, then return to setup. Workspace files and their passwords remain unchanged.
resetBackup: A backup of this preferences file will be kept beside it.
requestHint: Send this public request to a workspace member. Verify the fingerprint together through a trusted channel.
requestPrivate: This request contains no private key or research data.
moveResumeReady: Ready to resume this workspace move.
copyResumeReady: Ready to resume this workspace copy.
checkReady: Read, write, rename and exclusive directory creation succeeded.
checkWorkspace: An existing workspace is here. Use Open workspace.
checkOccupied: This folder contains other files; choose a dedicated empty folder.
databaseOwned: This workspace owns its database files. Copy and Move include the database, research history and attachments.
databaseExternal: This installation uses an explicitly configured external PostgreSQL server. Its administrator manages database files. Use a portable copy to transfer the workspace to another installation.
moveInterrupted: A verified move destination is ready. Open it to continue and finish removing the original. The original is protected against further edits.
